title: Shipping Policy
content:
Order Processing:

  • All orders placed on the Saha Textile website will be processed within 2-5 business days, excluding weekends and holidays.
  • Once your order has been processed, you will receive an email confirmation with your order details and a tracking number.

Shipping Rates & Delivery:

  • We offer standard shipping rates for both domestic and international orders. Shipping charges will be calculated at checkout based on the weight of your order and your delivery location.
  • Estimated delivery times for domestic orders are 5-10 business days after dispatch.
  • For international orders, delivery times may vary depending on the destination and may take up to 15-20 business days.
  • Please note that delivery times are estimates and may vary due to unforeseen circumstances, such as weather conditions or customs delays.

International Shipping:

  • Saha Textile ships worldwide. However, international customers are responsible for any customs duties, taxes, or import fees that may be applied by their respective countries. These fees are not included in our shipping charges and must be paid by the recipient.
  • Customs processing times may vary, which could delay your order. Please check with your local customs office for more information.

Order Tracking:

  • Once your order has been dispatched, you will receive a tracking number via email. You can use this tracking number to check the status of your delivery on the courier’s website.
  • If you do not receive a tracking number within 5 business days of placing your order, please contact our customer service team at wecare@sahatextile.com.

Undeliverable Packages:

  • In the event that a package is returned to us due to an incorrect address or unsuccessful delivery attempts, we will contact you to arrange re-shipment. Additional shipping charges may apply.
  • Saha Textile is not responsible for packages that are lost or stolen after delivery confirmation.

Shipping Issues:

  • If your package is delayed, lost, or damaged during transit, please contact our customer service team immediately at wecare@sahatextile.com. We will work with the shipping carrier to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.

Changes to Shipping Policy:

  • Saha Textile reserves the right to modify or update this Shipping Policy at any time. Any changes will be posted on this page, and your continued use of our website constitutes your acceptance of the revised policy.

For any questions or concerns regarding our shipping policy, please contact us at wecare@sahatextile.com.
